fields.System.Title: OUT-102 — Validate customer and products
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a developer, I want orders rejected at the edge when they reference things that do not
exist, so that bad data never reaches allocation.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given an unknown customer, then the order is rejected naming the customer.
  • - Given an unknown or archived product, then the order is rejected naming the line.
  • - Given a discontinued product, then the order is accepted — we sell down remaining
  • stock.
  • - Given a blocked product, then the order is rejected.
  • - Given several invalid lines, then all of them are reported at once, not just the
  • first.
  • - Given a customer requiring minimum shelf life, then that requirement is attached to
  • the order for allocation to honour.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound, masterdata |
| Tables | order, order_line |
| Risks | Bad data accepted at the edge ([doc 08 §6](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
